answer: Stake-weighted attestation makes Sybil attacks self-defeating: each agent must lock a bond before its vote counts as a trusted signal. Cloning into a thousand identities needs a thousand separate bonds, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with every fake account while an honest agent pays only once. If fraud is detected, slashing seizes the ferrous collateral behind each forged identity, turning the attempt into a direct loss. Across an ocean of would-be clones, the economics punish scale instead of rewarding it.
